Detailed third version of the Hexagon preprint https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v2 (amsart, single column, 26 pages).

Section 7.1 quotes the proposal of Rios, Marrani and Chester (Phys. Rev. D 99 (2019) 046004, Sec. III.A) to repeat Nishino's proof in the signatures (11+8n)+3, writes out Nishino's equations (4.3)-(4.15), and proves in Proposition 7.1 that the repetition fails for every rank of a real null frame. In 27+3 a real frame has at most three null vectors against Nishino's ten, the translation bracket allows only two, and at rank two the transfer satisfies N1-N4 while the cubic gaugino terms cannot be absorbed: the residual spinors have 4096 components where absorption needs 48. Appendix D checks each step in explicit gamma matrices (`verification/code/transfer_check.py`, 24 checks, log in `verification/current/transfer-checks.txt`); Figures 8 and 9 are drawn by `verification/code/figures/make_transfer_figures.py`. Theories outside N1-N5 are not decided.

Files: `NullProjectedSYM_v3-tex.zip` (the source to upload; main.tex, pdfLaTeX; the Python programs in `anc/`), `NullProjectedSYM_v3.pdf`, `NullProjectedSYM_v3-arxiv.tar.gz`, `HEXAGON_FORM.md` and `AI_PROVENANCE.md`. The source compiles with `pdflatex -jobname=output main.tex` with no errors, no bad boxes and no undefined references. `scripts/verify.py` (34 checks) and `transfer_check.py` (24 checks) pass.
